FN-TJVY959-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 407
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Pettus
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/08/2024
House Bill 407 as introduced could increase income tax receipts to the Education Trust Fund by
an undetermined amount dependent on the difference in the amount of income exempted under
current law and the amount of income that would be exempt for overtime compensation as
provided by federal law.
